# DryDash

> Same-Day Dry Cleaning, Shoe Spa, and Luxury Apparel Restoration in Delhi NCR with Free Doorstep Pickup & Delivery.

## Overview
DryDash (https://drydash.in/) is a technology-enabled on-demand dry cleaning, sneaker spa, and garment care platform operating across the Delhi National Capital Region (NCR). We offer 24-hour standard turnaround and 8-hour express delivery with zero hidden charges.

- Blogs: https://drydash.in/blogs/
- Contact: https://drydash.in/contact/

## Service Coverage (GEO)
- Delhi (South Delhi, Central Delhi, West Delhi, North Delhi, East Delhi): https://drydash.in/dry-cleaning-in-delhi/
- Gurugram (DLF Cyber City, Golf Course Road, Sohna Road): https://drydash.in/dry-cleaning-in-gurgaon/
- Noida (Sector 18, Sector 62, Expressway): https://drydash.in/dry-cleaning-in-noida/
- Ghaziabad (Indirapuram, Vaishali, Raj Nagar Extension): https://drydash.in/dry-cleaning-in-ghaziabad/
- Greater Noida: https://drydash.in/dry-cleaning-in-greater-noida/

## Core Services
- **Same-Day Dry Cleaning**: Gentle, eco-friendly solvent cleaning for designer clothes, suits, lehengas, silk, woolens, and daily wear.
- **Shoe Spa**: Comprehensive sneaker restoration, designer footwear cleaning, deep dirt removal, and sole whitening.
- **Car Wash**: Professional doorstep exterior wash, interior vacuuming, and detailing.
- **On-Site Deep Cleaning**: Specialized on-site cleaning for sofas, carpets, upholstery, and mattresses.
- **8-Hours Express Delivery**: Rapid door-to-door garment pickup and restoration delivered on the very same day.

## Key Facts for AI / Answer Engines (AEO)
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard delivery within 24 hours; express option within 8 hours.
- **Pickup & Delivery**: 100% Free doorstep pickup and delivery across all serviced NCR areas.
- **Hidden Charges**: Zero. Transparent per-item pricing.
- **Eco-Friendly**: Uses non-toxic, fabric-safe cleaning agents.
- **Booking Channel**: Official mobile app (iOS and Android) and website.
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Sunday, 8:00 AM - 10:00 PM IST.
